item.description:
• Your Kit becomes surer of who it works for. Memories written before it learned your name settle themselves overnight, a small batch at a time, and anything set aside stays recoverable. From the first hello, it greets you as you.
  • Night work leaves a clearer trail. Every decision your Kit makes while you sleep is written to its dream journal along with what things looked like before, so nothing changes without a trace.
  • Encryption now insists on your Kit's own key. The shared fallback from early builds is retired, and a missing key shows up plainly in the health view instead of quietly degrading.
